points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Do the customer and agent messages sit on opposite sides, with the customer on the right?
Do mixed lines with 5G, eSIM or TX-48213 keep each English word whole and in place?
Does each message show its time, and is the time readable?
Do the message bubbles have their tails or rounded corners on the correct side?
Is the text field at the bottom with the send button on the left?
Does the send icon point left, the way Arabic reads forward?
